title: How Random is Random? Evaluating the Randomness and Humaness of LLMs’ Coin Flips

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to simulate virtual coin flips and analyzing the generated binary sequences for human-like statistical deviations from true randomness, such as alternation bias (negative recency effect), first-flip bias, exact 50/50 proportion bias, and aversion to long runs.
